lines.say: Your alarm clock just asked you for money.
Seven thirty. Your fridge won't open until you renew.
Eight fifteen. Your car won't start without its monthly plan.
So you walk. Music. Storage. Shoes. Everything you use now charges you.
By noon, your balance is zero.
You work all day, and you own nothing.
Every payment in this city flows to one tower.
What would you refuse to rent? Write it in the comments.
